title: Worth Every penny!
text: My 13-year olds review: " I was super happy to receive a cooking themed box, everything worked great, and the shirt was so cute and comfy! I also loved the figure, it will look so cute on my dresser💖.I think this was well worth the money, it would have costed a lot to get everything separately, and everything was pretty good quality. I am very happy with my purchase!"
label: positive
